answer: The nectar chain is verified at intake and spiral publishes each anchor. To earn at all, an identity must present a signature chain reaching back to a settlement at least 10 epochs old, anchored at a vertex checkpoint. A newly minted alias has no such history, which means it must survive 10 epochs before its first payout, and abandoning it forfeits the wait. Every extra alias adds 14 hours of verification and 6 percent more locked value. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
